usedFor: Clicksign runs the signing, and a signer event like “New Signer” can add someone through “Create Contact” in Google Contacts.

bestTemplate.name: “New Signer” in Clicksign, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: A signer added to a document becomes a Google Contacts entry, so your address book grows as documents go out.

watchOut: “Add Contact to Group” finds a contact first, so run “Create Contact” before it for new signers.
